### [component] Stats Card  [id: 8321]
by ravikatiyar162
Stats Card
This component is designed to display a single, key statistic. It includes a title, a primary value, an icon, and a percentage change indicator that is color-coded for positive or negative trends.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/ravikatiyar162/stats-card-1/default/preview.1759173339031.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ravikatiyar162/stats-card-1?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 8321 })

### [component] Stats Card  [id: 7841]
by kavikatiyar
Stats Card
This is a reusable card component designed to display a key metric, a descriptive summary, and a mini bar chart for trend visualization. It features animations that trigger when the component enters the view.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/kavikatiyar/stats-card-1/default/preview.1758356287705.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/kavikatiyar/stats-card-1?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 7841 })

### [component] Statistics Card 10  [id: 4245]
by sean0205
Statistics Card is designed to present key metrics and insights featuring unique layouts, data visualizations, and styling options. Perfect for dashboards, admin panels, and analytics pages.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/sean0205/statistics-card-10/default/preview.1753168295511.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/sean0205/statistics-card-10?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 4245 })

Metadata is free. get_component (the code) is the PAID step - on the free tier it uses your daily retrieval quota (see get_usage).
